speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever after your recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. Can you tell me if the pain in your side is constant or does it come and go, and does it radiate to your groin?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Did the flank pain become more severe when you take deep breaths or move suddenly, and have you noticed any changes in your urine color or frequency?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia Present, Bacterial_Culture Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel's_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm; Renal_Ultrasound: NORMAL READINGS (not provided in data)

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand your concern, and based on your history of fever and flank pain following antibiotic treatment, along with the pending urinalysis and ultrasound, I am ready to finalize the diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (complicated by antibiotic allergy)
